name: Church Structure
overview: Scripture outlines a divinely appointed church structure characterized by qualified leadership and the distribution of spiritual gifts for the building up of the body. Acts 6:3 emphasizes selecting men of good reputation, filled with the Holy Spirit and wisdom, to oversee church responsibilities. Ephesians 4:11 describes Christ giving various roles such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers to equip the saints. Additionally, Titus 1:6 highlights the moral qualifications required for leadership, while Romans 12:13 encourages believers to actively care for one another's needs and practice hospitality within the community.
